started.purpose: Detailed report, recorded-data plots and computed annotated crops; public-only audit. No new inference/training/parameter selection.

scope: Detailed methods and source-row links, scientific plots, computed annotated crops, public artifact-consistency verifier and loss-mask inspection. No additional experimental model/threshold/seed selection.

additional_execution.loss_checks: First captured existing batch targets; second optional public-snapshot rerun reproduced the loss/checks exactly. Neither call instantiated or ran the learned head.
additional_execution.read_only_public_verification: Recorded isolated tests in REVIEW_VALIDATION_TESTS.json and current final artifact checks in REVIEW_CHECKS.json. Public consistency checks do not rerun the experiment.
additional_execution.visualization_rerenders: Plots and overlays were redrawn for legibility using fixed recorded results and cached masks. No configuration or score selection changed.

limits: Illustrative cases were selected after evaluation by explicit deterministic criteria; they do not replace the all319 comparison.
Public verification can check stored results and integrity; private RGB/model/full pose ground truth replay requires the dependencies in REPRODUCE.md.
Original physical reference limitations, historical missing R/t and unexecuted E6 controls remain disclosed.

publication.receipt_policy: Original PUBLICATION.json remains the immutable first publication receipt. Current Git commit identifies this review revision; final remote SHA is compared with local HEAD after push.
